in_sanskrit.name: अर्थ:
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Artha in Sanskrit can mean 'purushartha' or 'the fourth goal of human life', 'wealth' or 'prosperity', or 'community'.

in_hindi.name: अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: Arth in Hindi can mean 'wealth', 'revered', or 'community'.

in_tamil.name: அர்த்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Arth in Tamil can mean 'artham' or 'prosperity', 'according to' or 'in accordance with', or 'community'.

in_telugu.name: అర్థ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Arth in Telugu can mean 'peshada' or 'wealth', 'pooja' or 'worship', or 'samudeshagina' or 'one who leads or guides the community'.

in_marathi.name: Arth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arth signifies wealth or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, it is a name of the god Indra, who is known as the deity of rain and thunder. In Sanskrit, Arth also means 'truth' or 'reality'.
